answer_1.quote: Lexical Substitution is the task of generating appropriate words which can replace a target word in a given sentence without changing the sentence's meaning... utility in various Natural Language Processing (NLP) fields including data augmentation, paraphrase generation and semantic text similarity.

answer_2.quote: We use the official metrics that the organizers provided in the original lexical substitution task of SemEval-2007. These were best and best-mode ... oot and oot-mode ... We also use Precision@1 ... For the candidate ranking task we use the GAP score.
